args.notes: DDS/NCO spec: needs 1 sample/clock at >=250 MSPS, so pipelined families (m>=1) are the natural fit; iterative (1 sample per n_iter cycles) likely fails throughput. Accuracy needs ~13 bits (max_abs_err <= 2^-13), so n_iter ~12-13 with dw ~15-16. Minimize LUTs. Prior campaigns: pipelined_m dominated bursty front (m=4..7, dw=15..20, n_iter=12..13); plain pipelined and unrolled_k never reached a front. Focus budget on pipelined_m with small m (m=1..4) and dw 14..18, n_iter 12..13.
